department: Faculty of Geo-information Science and Earth Observation (ITC)

deadline.value: The ITC page gives no closing date; a PhD study can start from a proposal in the registration procedure.
deadline.quote: A PhD study programme may be initiated on the basis of a proposal submitted by the PhD candidate as part of the registration procedure.

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is stated for ITC.

supervisor.value: The ITC page says a PhD runs under a promoter and daily supervisors, but does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: under the supervision of a promoter and one or more daily supervisors

funding.value: ITC does not offer fellowships or similar funding for self-initiated PhD candidates, except for advertised vacancies it has already funded.
funding.quote: ITC does not offer fellowships or similar funding for PhD candidates (except for advertised vacancies for which ITC has already secured funding).

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a master's degree or an equivalent qualification.
entry_route.quote: Hold a MSc degree or an equivalent qualification from an officially recognised university or accredited academic institution.

app_fee.value: ITC sets its own registration; its application fee was not found on the pages checked, so the university-wide rule does not apply.

fee_waiver.value: ITC sets its own registration; its fee waiver rules were not found on the pages checked.

gre_general.value: ITC sets its own registration; its GRE rule was not found on the pages checked.

toefl_min.value: ITC sets its own registration; its TOEFL minimum was not found on the pages checked, so the university-wide score does not apply.

ielts_min.value: ITC sets its own registration; its IELTS minimum was not found on the pages checked, so the university-wide score does not apply.

english_waiver.value: ITC sets its own registration; its English waiver rules were not found on the pages checked.

notes: ITC runs its own registration (quote on the program page: At the end of the self-assessment, you can find a link to on-line application for registration in the Graduate Programme). The ITC admission page returned 404 (https://www.utwente.nl/en/itc/education/admission/), so ITC's own English and fee rules are not checked. The tuition table on the ITC page is split and not quoted. Discipline is not named on the page, so 'environment' is a judgement from the ITC Earth Observation remit. Checked 2026-10-26.
